items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: By the way, Casimir called me and told me he was going to shoot me regularly. He ain't going to fool with Knox no more.

ctx.x: The 17th. Is it Monday or Tuesday? Oh the 17th, that's next month. Tuesday. Tuesday. Memorial Day we go. With Casimir down there. Yeah, with Casimir. The Quban down to Chalmette. That soldier's grave.
By the way, Casimir called me and told me he was going to shoot me regularly. He ain't going to fool with Knox no more.
Well Knox, do you want to pay his union?
